reviewType: Bounded overdue factual review of the azelaprag sponsor statement, trial record and corroborating annual filing
editorialAuthorisation: Matt's standing authority covers evidence-backed informational Watch updates. This is not clinical approval.

sources.title: BioAge Labs: STRIDES Phase 2 discontinuation
sources.assessment: The complete current sponsor announcement was retrieved and read. It still reports the 6 December 2024 decision to discontinue STRIDES after liver transaminitis without clinically significant symptoms in some participants receiving azelaprag, with no transaminase elevations reported in the tirzepatide-only group. It still records 204 enrolled participants, 11 observations in azelaprag groups, stopped dosing and enrolment, and off-drug follow-up. The normalized claim fingerprint remains identical despite a later HTTP Last-Modified value.
sources.uncertainty: This is a sponsor report. It does not independently establish causation, a rate outside the studied regimens, an efficacy or muscle-function result, UK authorisation, NICE/NHS access, actual UK supply or clinical approval.

registrySources.whyStopped: Dosing of both study drugs has been discontinued due to observation of liver transaminitis without clinically significant symptoms in some subjects receiving azelaprag. All participant visits have been completed.
registrySources.assessment: The complete current sponsor-submitted API record was retrieved and read. It remains terminated with the same stopping reason, actual enrolment and dates, and no posted results. The normalized lifecycle fingerprint remains identical.

programme.assessment: The discontinued programme summary remains accurate after rereading the complete sponsor announcement, complete registry record and complete BioAge annual filing. No efficacy, body-composition or muscle-preservation result is posted or inferred.

additionalEvidence.assessment: The complete filing was reread. It states that BioAge terminated development of azelaprag in January 2025. The filing creation timestamp and official SEC Last-Modified header verify 20 March 2025 as the publication date, correcting the earlier unverified null date without changing the programme claim.

finding: Both configured sources and the wider programme summary are unchanged after actual primary-source review. Successful HTTP checks were not used as review substitutes. The SEC filing date is now verified as 20 March 2025; no medical wording changes.

remainingObstacles.obstacle: The configured sponsor monitor still receives HTTP 403 and has no approved baseline; accessible Zealand evidence remains internally inconsistent about Phase 1 versus preclinical or first-in-human state.
remainingObstacles.nextAction: Retain registry and CTIS corroboration while deliberately reviewing a stable directly reviewable Zealand artefact or a bounded replacement source; do not repeatedly retry the denied endpoint.

monitoring: Recurring configured-source freshness, programme-summary reviews and broader discovery remain open.
